name: ORCA Hand
summary: Open-source, Reliable, Cost-Effective, Anthropomorphic — a 17-DOF tendon-driven hand from ETH Zurich, 3D-printed for under about 2,000 CHF and assembled in under a day, with joints designed to pop rather than break under overload. It withstands 10,000+ operation cycles and ships with full design files, control code and sim environments.
